summary: Nuveen Farmland REIT filed an 8-K reporting entry into an advisory agreement with Nuveen Farmland Advisors LLC and an amended and restated limited partnership agreement for its operating partnership, both dated September 1, 2026, plus a second amended intermediary manager agreement with Nuveen Securities, LLC. These are customary internal governance and service contracts for a newly formed REIT conducting a continuous private offering, not a transformative event. No board recommendation, pricing, or risk-arb angle; watch for future filings indicating fundraising performance or any strategic shift.
